author: reek
body: Event delegation for explorer dropdown items. Replaces inline onclick="pick(...)" handlers with data-action="pick" dispatch. Reads the group and index from data-value, then calls the existing pick callback registered via register-handlers.

author: reek
body: Migration note: new designer pages should use the widget-based Dropdown from codex.foreword.ui instead of this DOM-event system. The Dropdown widget handles filtering, keyboard navigation, and open/close state internally.
